features.title: Discovery pipeline — UserIntent → PaymentIntent[]
features.user_visible_behavior: Raw purchase intent in, structured PaymentIntent[] out. Foundation for all downstream agent stages.
verification: cd apps/agents && npm run test:discovery
evidence: npm run test:discovery → VALIDATION PASSED — 5 options returned, all required fields present
Exa Agent mode: attempt 1, stopReason: schema_satisfied, cost: $0.50
Augmented query contains no platform names
Fallback path (searchAndContents + GPT-4o) also verified passing on timeout runs
features.agent_notes: exa-js v2.13.0 used (Agent API at exa.beta.agent.runs). No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env — llm.ts auto-falls back to GPT-4o. Poll timeout is 300s; Exa Agent typically completes in 2–3 min. Timeout errors are non-transient (not retried). JSON parse and 5xx errors trigger up to 3 retries with 2s delay.
